system.description:
You deal horrendous damage while raging.

Prerequisites: Rage Species Trait, Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: While Raging, your Rage bonus on melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls increases to +5.

Normal: A character with the Rage Species Trait gains a +2 bonus on melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls while Raging.
